description: Main window: the app's own commands (allowed without a core permission) plus listening to the app's events. Nothing else from core except starting a window drag (the macOS title bar is hidden; `data-tauri-drag-region` on the sidebar top moves the window): the UI uses no other window, app, path, menu, tray, image or webview APIs. No plugin permissions either: the dialog and opener plugins are used only from Rust, behind the validated `pick_folders` and `open_url` commands.
